goblin-citizen.summary: The model is a friendly goblin trader with large ears, a vest, a red sash, striped trousers, and a brass bell. It is the same character as the mockup, but the bell is upside down in the fist, the arm is low, and the backpack is small.
strengths: The large green ears, the face, and the friendly smile read well in every view and at 128 px.
The costume colors match the mockup: cream shirt, brown vest with gold buttons, red sash, purple striped trousers, red shoes.
The model stands on the ground and the walk clip is clean.
issues: The bell is upside down relative to the grip. The crown and its knob point up, and the fist holds a short stem below the bell mouth. Put the handle in the fist and hang the bell below it, mouth down.
The arm holds the bell at chest height. The mockup holds the bell up at head height. Raise the arm.
The backpack is a small box with two pots. The mockup and the role show a huge sack of odds and ends. Make the pack larger than the torso and add more items.
The head covering is a yellow pointed cap. The mockup shows an orange bandana with a knot. Change the cap to a wrapped orange bandana.
The neck scarf is a plain yellow ring. The mockup shows an orange scarf with a hanging end. Add the hanging end and use orange.
goblin-citizen.next: Turn the bell so that the fist holds the handle and the bell hangs below it, and raise the arm to head height.
goblin-citizen.criticalReason: The held bell points the wrong way: its crown points up and the fist holds the mouth end, not the handle.

orc-citizen.summary: The model is a big, gentle orc farmer in a plaid shirt and overalls, with a straw hat and a basket of vegetables. It is the same character as the mockup, with one clear difference in the hat.
strengths: The red plaid shirt, the blue overalls, the rolled light-blue cuffs, and the brown boots match the mockup well.
The raised fist and the basket on the other arm match the mockup pose.
The broad body and the soft face give a gentle, friendly read.
issues: The hat is a shallow smooth cone with red bands. The mockup shows a wide round woven straw hat with a crown. Give the hat a crown, a round brim, and a woven texture.
The basket hangs low in the hand. The mockup carries the basket in the crook of the arm at hip height. Raise the basket to the elbow.
The smile is small with two lower tusks. The mockup shows a wide open grin. Widen the mouth.
From the high sprite angles the flat hat hides most of the face. A hat with a crown and a tilt shows more of the face.
The vegetables are normal size. The role says giant vegetables. Make one pumpkin or cabbage larger.
orc-citizen.next: Change the hat to a wide round woven straw hat with a crown.

lizardfolk-citizen.summary: The model is a green lizardfolk trader with a teal headband, a shell necklace, a knit vest, a leather wrap, and a long tail. It is the same character, but the head is small and shaped like a crocodile, so the face is noticeably different from the round chibi mockup.
strengths: The scale texture, the knit vest, and the leather wrap are clearly different materials.
The long tail and the clawed feet give a clear lizard silhouette from the side and in the sprites.
The shell necklace and the teal headband show the river trader role.
issues: The head is small for the body, and the long wide snout with high eyes reads as a crocodile. The mockup has a large round head with a short rounded snout. Enlarge the head and shorten and round the snout.
The spiral shell is small and flat, and it reads as a pink candy. The mockup and the role show a big spiral seashell. Make the shell larger and give it depth and a shell opening.
The torso is long and the arms are long. The mockup body is short and squat. Shorten the torso.
The crest is thin and reads as a stick from the side. Make the crest wider at the base.
The free arm hangs down. The mockup waves this hand. Raise the free arm to wave height.
lizardfolk-citizen.next: Enlarge the head and change the snout to a short rounded chibi snout.

merfolk-citizen.summary: The model is a cheerful merfolk boy with teal hair, a teal shirt, scaled shorts, a rope belt with a starfish, and a teal fish tail. It is the same character as the mockup, with clear differences in the hair, the pearl, and the shirt front.
strengths: The fish tail with its large fin, the scaled shorts, and the rope belt with the starfish match the mockup well.
The open happy smile and the raised arm with the pearl match the mockup.
The teal and orange colors match the mockup palette, and the identity reads at 128 px.
issues: The hair is a mass of long spikes that point up and out like seaweed. The mockup shows soft wavy hair. Make the locks shorter and rounder.
The pearl is a plain white ball with no glow. The role says glowing pearl, and the mockup shows a bright light. Make the pearl emissive with a warm glow.
The shirt front has a slot that shows skin from the chest to the belt, with an orange bead and a tan drop in it. It reads as a cut in the shirt. Close the slot and hang the pendant on the shirt.
The shirt is wide and boxy. The mockup shirt is shorter and looser at the hem. Shorten the hem.
merfolk-citizen.next: Change the hair to soft wavy locks and make the pearl glow.
